description: Land Title Settlement Department - Delgamuwa, Warakapola D/S Division, Kegalle District - Cad. Map No. 610092 (23/0880)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, extents, ownership details (all listed as "The State"), and legal descriptions of the properties. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land ownership and title settlement matters, fitting perfectly within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
